Daily gravel rally

SIDEWAYS

A new gravel stage every day. Five sectors, one clock, unlimited attempts.

How to drift
  • Tap brake while turning to kick the rear out.
  • Hold throttle to keep the drift going.
  • Lift off to rotate more, counter-steer to straighten or flick.
  • Space handbrake for hairpins.
  • G turns on the racing line assist, a gentle pull toward the ideal line.
  • R restarts the stage, T puts you back at the last checkpoint (+5 s).

CLASSICS

These five never change and are the same for everyone, so you can race your mates' times. Beat the target times for bronze, silver and gold.

CAREER

Season calendar

Championship

Three stages a rally against seven rivals; your rally time is the three stage times added up. Points for the rally result: 25, 18, 15, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4. No retries: restarting a stage costs 10 s. Win the championship to move up a class.

Race your friends live

MULTIPLAYER

Live races work on the shared claude.ai page of the game. Open it there, share it with your friends from its Share menu, and come back here.
